title: Sources: DeepSeek is in talks to raise funds, and the Big Fund, China's biggest state-backed chip fund, is seeking to lead the investment at a ~$45B valuation (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: DeepSeek is in talks to raise funds, and the Big Fund, China's biggest state-backed chip fund, is seeking to lead the investment at a ~$45B valuation — Value soars in ongoing fundraising discussions as investors including Tencent seek slice of AI lab
